Needs changes before merge: complete the required heavy checks.

The source review found no new code defect. The targeted tests and both mutation checks support this fix.
This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects the generated toolpath.

**Local results**

Base: upstream main `aa4c785db`. The PR already contains this base. The trial merge required no changes.
The review used its own local worktree and target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: all 6 steps |
| Motion build, debug, `--no-run` | PASS |
| Motion unit tests | 490 passed; 10 ignored |
| `rest_corner_relief` | 2 passed |
| `rest_zigzag` | 2 passed |
| `rest2d` | 13 passed |
| App `rest_pocket` | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| Motion and app release build, `--no-run` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | INCOMPLETE: 159 of 236 steps completed; time limit at step 160 |

**Mutations**

1. Restore upstream main's `rest2d.rs`: both new tests failed at their expected assertions.
2. Keep the new note, but remove the tolerance from the containment test: the four-corner test failed at line 72.
3. Restore the PR source: both new tests passed. The working tree was clean after the checks.

Both red runs reported:

```text
Waterline: rest pass missed dogbone ends [Point2 { x: 27.878679656440358, y: 27.878679656440358 }, Point2 { x: 2.1213203435596424, y: 27.878679656440358 }, Point2 { x: 27.878679656440358, y: 2.1213203435596424 }]
```

**Extra suites run**

The diff changes no fixture, golden, test data, or importer. The extra fixture and importer suites do not apply.
The local heavy run covered all motion heavy targets and app targets through `rotary_face_selection`.
The table below lists each step that ran. Known-failure checks matched the expected failures.
No golden moved. There was no changed golden to inspect line by line.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs:254`: complete the heavy verification that this source change requires.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under **Heavy lanes at review**, requires the reached motion and app lanes to pass.
   The PR body says that these lanes were not run. This review also could not complete them within its time budget.
   Run the incomplete and remaining heavy steps on the final head. Add the commands and results to the PR body.
   A later comment can name this finding and link the evidence for a review of the same head.

The review ran this command with a 30-minute limit:

```text
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 1800s cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main
exit status: 124
```

The limit stopped `app heavy: rotary_field_parity`. Three of its six tests passed before the limit.
The other three tests did not return a result. The following 76 steps did not start.
This is incomplete verification. No unexpected test failure was observed.

**Notes**

The relief planner still checks the spur against other pocket walls. The new tolerance selects existing validated spurs.
The shared spur emitter can still omit a kept relief when no pass vertex can connect to it.
The PR body identifies that existing limit. This review does not treat it as a new defect.
No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects generated toolpaths.

The later [evidence comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3149#issuecomment-7066719659) answers the one finding in the earlier review.
The updated PR body records the required motion and app heavy checks on this unchanged head.
No blocking finding remains.

**Source checks**

- The tolerance selects reliefs from the existing validated plan. It does not change their coordinates.
- The relief planner still checks each spur against the other pocket walls.
- The two new tests check all four dogbones and the note for a relief outside the rest area.
- No UI file changed. Before and after screenshots are not required.
- No golden changed. There was no changed golden to check line by line.

**Local results merged with main**

The trial merge with upstream main `4e0c819643d37d8abcf815635bd420b355f74b3b` was clean.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3149`, with its own target directory.
No GitHub runner was used. The commands disabled sccache.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: all 6 steps |
| Motion build, `--no-run` | PASS |
| Motion unit tests | 503 passed; 10 ignored |
| Motion `rest_corner_relief` | 2 passed |
| Motion `rest_zigzag` | 2 passed |
| Motion `rest2d` | 13 passed |
| App `rest_pocket` | 6 passed |
| Restored source: motion `rest_corner_relief` | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

The workspace manifest reports an unused `truck-polymesh` dependency. This PR does not change that dependency.

**Mutations**

I repeated both checks on the trial merge:

1. Restore upstream main's `rest2d.rs`: both new tests failed. The failures named the three missed dogbones and the missing note.
2. Keep the note, but use bare `plan.center.contains(r.start)`: the four-corner test failed at line 72. The note test passed.
3. Restore the reviewed source: both tests passed. `git status --short` was empty after the checks.

The four-corner failure in both red runs was:

```text
Waterline: rest pass missed dogbone ends [Point2 { x: 27.878679656440358, y: 27.878679656440358 }, Point2 { x: 2.1213203435596424, y: 27.878679656440358 }, Point2 { x: 27.878679656440358, y: 2.1213203435596424 }]
```

**Extra suites run**

No additional fixture or importer suite applies. The PR changes no test data, fixture, golden, or importer.
The local quick gate ran all five selected test suites listed above.

**Heavy verification evidence**

The author reports `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 236 steps on the unchanged PR head.
The run took 89.2 minutes. The six known-failure checks matched their expected failures.
Motion had 37 successful steps. App had 198 successful steps. The release build was the remaining step.
`rotary_field_parity` passed all 6 tests. The 76 later steps passed, including all 6 `shared_face_bodies_finish` tests.

I accept this final-head evidence for the earlier incomplete-heavy-check finding.
I did not repeat the heavy run in this review. The fresh local quick gate and mutations above use current upstream main.

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes**

The shared spur emitter can still omit a relief when no pass vertex can connect to it.
The PR body identifies this existing limit. This PR does not change that emitter.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
